description: ID of the stem measurement record, unique within the acquisition.
Acquisition ID. The mid-date of stem measurements within the site for this acquisition. YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, or YYYY, in order of preference.
Plot name, unique within the site.
Census ID for the plot. E.g. "1" for the first census in the plot, "2" for the second census.
The mid-date of the census in the plot. This can be either YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, or YYYY, in order of preference.
If the plot is divided into multiple parcels, the parcel within which the stem is found. Unique within the plot.
Unique identifier for individual trees within a plot, normally the stem_id of the first or largest stem within the tree.
Unique identifier for stems within a plot. Normally the tag ID.
Measurement ID. If a stem has multiple measurements within a single census.
The date of the measurement. This should ideally be YYYY-MM-DD. YYYY-MM and YYYY are also accepted.
The taxonomic name of the tree.
The X coordinate of the stem within the plot. In metres to nearest 10 cm (one decimal place).
The Y coordinate of the stem within the plot. In metres to nearest 10 cm (one decimal place).
Stem diameter measurement in cm to nearest mm (one decimal place).
The height at which 'diam' was measured. Point of Measurement (POM). In metres to nearest nearest 10 cm (one decimal place).
The height of the tree, in metres to nearest 10 cm (one decimal place). Note: we are aware that the accuracy of tree height field measurements may be less than 10 cm.
Indicate stem mortality and condition. See Table 2 for more information on these codes
Miscellaneous notes for each stem measurement
